Simulate multiple latent trajectories

Source: R/13_helpers.R
simulate_intrinsic_trajectories.Rd

Generate sample-by-feature data with one signal-feature block per ordering and an optional noise-only block. Return truth alongside the observations.

Usage

simulate_intrinsic_trajectories(
  n = 200,
  d_signal = c(30, 30),
  d_noise = 20,
  noise_sd = 0.3,
  trajectory_family = "sinusoidal",
  seed = 42L,
  control = NULL
)

Arguments

n

Number of samples; default 200.

d_signal

Nonnegative signal-feature counts, one per ordering.

d_noise

Number of noise-only features; default 20.

noise_sd

Gaussian observation-noise standard deviation; default 0.3.

trajectory_family

"sinusoidal", "linear", "monotone", or "quadratic", as one family or one per ordering.

seed

Optional random seed; default 42.

control

Named advanced settings list: signal_range = c(0.5, 2) (signal amplitudes), linear_slope_range = c(0.8, 2), monotone_power_range = c(0.7, 2.5), quadratic_curvature_range = c(0.8, 2), quadratic_center_range = c(0.25, 0.75), intercept_sd = 0, sinusoid_freq = 1:4 (sampled frequencies), latent_positions = NULL. Non-NULL positions must be an n-by-ordering-count matrix. Otherwise positions are sampled uniformly on [0,1]. Parameter ranges affect their corresponding trajectory families. Unknown settings are rejected.

Value

A list containing X, true_assign, latent_positions, ordering_labels, original_order, and trajectory_family.

Examples

simulate_intrinsic_trajectories(n = 30, d_signal = c(3, 3), d_noise = 2,
  trajectory_family = "linear", control = list(linear_slope_range = c(1, 2)))
